prompt:

| Return 1m            | +8.2% |
| Return 1w            | +4.9% |
| Range position (63d) | 87% |

raw_response:

The high range position (87%) suggests the stock is trading near its recent highs, which, combined with the positive returns, points to continued strength. DECISION: BUY
